description: This file defines interfaces for browser control and web browser functionalities within the WPEFramework, including URL management, visibility, cookies, scripting, security, and event notifications.

classes.name: IBrowser
classes.description: Interface for direct access to browser properties and notifications.

classes.name: IWebBrowser
classes.description: Extended interface for web browser functionalities including URL, visibility, FPS, user agent, cookies, and garbage collection.

classes.name: IBrowserResources
classes.description: Interface for managing browser resources like headers, user scripts, and style sheets.

classes.name: IBrowserSecurity
classes.description: Interface for security settings such as security profile and mixed content policy.

classes.name: IBrowserScripting
classes.description: Interface for executing JavaScript and managing user scripts.

classes.name: IBrowserCookieJar
classes.description: Interface for managing browser cookies and cookie jar change notifications.

methods.name: GetFPS
methods.description: Get the current framerate of the browser.

methods.name: Hide
methods.description: Set the visibility of the browser.

methods.name: LoadFinished
methods.description: Notification when page load is finished.

methods.name: PageClosure
methods.description: Notification that the page requests to close.

methods.name: BridgeQuery
methods.description: Send a message to the bridge.

methods.name: UserAgent
methods.description: Get or set the user agent string.

methods.name: LocalStorageEnabled
methods.description: Get or set local storage availability.

methods.name: HTTPCookieAcceptPolicy
methods.description: Get or set HTTP cookie accept policy.
